scope: Engineering fixture only. Stage 1a does not materialize a research split, score a child on a facility, release DEV, or access H2 or H3.
mutable_rule: Only R can replace the root with one of twelve signed cell/companion emit_then macros. A complete admissible paid single edit with strictly smaller summed L than the starting incumbent supplies credit. Tie order is L, person, six levels. O performs the same credit audit and retains base. Terminal rounds select the child and leave the program alone. Original grammar, score, caps, cell levels, selection and the rewrite rule are immutable.
